title: TDIST: 14 of 60 on the b22 held-out gate

upstream_anchor.section: Accurate-complement stagings landed at the wrappers

status_plain: Landing the accurate-complement argument staging -- x = df/den, y = t^2/den -- moved TDIST from 6 to 14 of 60 on the b22 gate, which the same section describes as 671 fresh live rows with disjoint values. The catalogue row does not carry this count at all; it gives only a worst-ULP movement from +-88 to +17. The one-tail equals half the two-tail statement beside it is an Excel-versus-Excel identity, not a pass rate.
